subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Despair
solution:
The correct answer is '**Optimism**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Despair**" refers to the feeling of losing all hope or confidence (निराशा).

 
 
• **Example**: After losing his job, he was filled with **despair**, unsure if he would find employment again.
 
 
 
• The correct word, "**Optimism**," signifies hopefulness and confidence about the future or the success of something (आशावाद).
 
 
• **Example**: Despite the challenges, she maintained her **optimism**, believing that things would eventually improve.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Distant **means far away in space or time (दूर).

 
 
• **Example**: He could barely see the **distant **mountains through the fog.
 
 
 
• **Sorrow **is a feeling of deep distress caused by loss, disappointment, or other misfortune suffered by oneself or others (दुःख).
 
 
• **Example**: Her heart was filled with **sorrow **after hearing the tragic news.
 
 
 
• **Distinct **means recognisably different in nature from something else of a similar type (स्पष्ट).
 
 
• **Example**: The **distinct **smell of freshly baked bread filled the room.
